# Fanfarr v0.5.26

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## Trim failures you can actually read

A trim that died on a YouTube source showed the download's progress lines and
cut off before the line that said why. Two fixes: the pin moves to yt-dlp
2026.10.26, a month fresher against YouTube's churn, and the error keeps the
last 500 characters of the transcript instead of the first, with the last 2000
logged server-side. The classifier reads the same tail, so a restriction at
the end of a long log is named rather than unknown.

## The eMudhra gap in yt-dlp is closed

The new pin reports certifi-2026.10.23, which already drops both compromised
roots. The notes now say to watch the pin rather than accepting a hole: every
TLS path in the image is covered, Erlang's through the patched system store
and yt-dlp's through its own bundle.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
